# SCI-FLT-MATCHED v0.1 r0.4 Notation Crosswalk

Status: second-review minor-repair notation; no option selected

| r0.3 form | r0.4 form | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| conditioning sometimes on g and sometimes on g plus theta | h equals the pair g and theta | Every fixed-state expectation, variance, reference covariance, and realized covariance conditions on one complete frozen condition. Variation over theta is U2. |
| covariance of the full failure-bearing producing map | covariance of the fixed selection P_C F_g(m), conditional on h | P_C selects one fixed predeclared finite numerical codomain. Almost-sure numerical production is required. |
| realized response with two or four arguments | realized response indexed by delta and sigma, with arguments m, p, and s | General operational response names reference parent, step, and derivative or sidedness scheme. Two-index shorthand is allowed only after fixed-state linearity is established. |
| undeclared numerical denominator in e_d | optional declared numerical normalization | It exists only when a numerical profile exposes an exact separable denominator; otherwise e_d is unavailable. |

All r0.3 collision repairs remain in force: p/q/s are map/template anchors,
xi_q is the radial local-chart coordinate, lambda indexed by p and b(k) is
regularization, and D_loc(p) precedes final S_apply(p).
